interpretation: The MX490 image includes a conventional zlib-style decompression wrapper and state machine. The four discovered payloads can therefore be analyzed as standard zlib resources without recovering a proprietary LZ decoder.
caveat: The static image does not expose a direct ARM BL caller for this wrapper; it may be reached through relocation tables or function pointers. This does not identify the payload destination or prove boot acceptance of a modified image.
